name: carcasonne-unlimited
description: Creates and morphs an unlimited map of tiles based on the game carcasonne

scripts.build: tsc src/game.ts --outFile dist/game.js --target ES2015 --lib ES2015,DOM && cp src/index.html dist/ && cp -r src/carcasonne-tiles dist/
scripts.dev: npm run build && python3 -m http.server 8000 --directory dist
